title: Product Manager, Google Partner Innovation
description:
For Singapore Applicants:


Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience developing and launching products or technologies within Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning (AI/ML).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience developing and launching successful products in AI/ML or related areas.
* Experience architecting agentic AI products utilizing tool\-calling, memory management, and evaluation pipelines.
* Profound experience in 'Vibe coding' via mainstream agentic tools, with willingness to dive into source code.
* Building products from the ground up in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Navigating complex infrastructure within large\-scale technical ecosystems and linking Google's latest AI models to applications driving growth.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conceptualize, prototype, and define groundbreaking AI product opportunities within dynamic and ambiguous consumer environments, showcasing the forefront of Google's AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with DeepMind, Core ML, and other engineering teams to transform research breakthroughs into impactful product features, ensuring smooth integration and market alignment with Google's strategic partners.
* Support the entire product development process, from ideation and prototyping to launch and ongoing iteration, guaranteeing the timely delivery of exceptional AI features that resonate with users.
* Partner with Product Alliance Managers across various initiatives to cultivate captivating narratives and go\-to\-market strategies that highlight the distinctive value proposition of Google's AI solutions.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Product Manager – Executive Education
description:

*We are looking for a Product Manager – Executive Education to conceptualise, design and evolve a differentiated portfolio of executive learning programmes across AI, Digital Transformation, Leadership, Strategy and emerging business themes.*

* Develop appropriate pedagogy including cases, simulations, projects, experiential learning, action learning and application\-based assignments.

* Excellent research, benchmarking, analytical and conceptualisation skills.
* Ability to understand enterprise challenges across strategy, people, processes, culture and technology.

* Commercial orientation with an understanding of market positioning, competitive differentiation and pricing.

*You are able to connect the dots between what enterprises need, what executives will value, what academia can credibly deliver and what the market will pay for.*

title: Learning Product Manager (Systems Management) - India (Remote)
description:
**Job Description: Product Manager – Systems Management**

**Company Introduction**

**CLaaS2SaaS** is a Singapore\-headquartered Pan\-ASEAN AI Acceleration Platform committed to advancing inclusive digital economy transformation across Southeast Asia. We work closely with higher education institutions, enterprises, SMEs, and governments to accelerate workforce and digital transformation in the AI era.

Driven by a Skills\-First, Work\-Integrated Learning innovation, CLaaS2SaaS combines work\-integrated learning with AI\-powered adaptive technologies to develop industry\-ready digital talent and support lifelong career growth. Our innovative learning ecosystem enables faster and more effective workforce transformation, empowering individuals with practical skills, real\-world industry experience, and meaningful career outcomes.

At the same time, we support enterprises in adopting intelligent digital solutions and scalable AI\-enabled services that enhance productivity, workforce capabilities, and operational efficiency. By connecting education, industry, and technology within a unified ecosystem, CLaaS2SaaS is building a more connected, agile, and AI\-powered ASEAN economy for the future.

**About the Job**

**Job Function \& Skills**

You will be responsible for **designing, developing, and managing IT Systems Management learning products and curriculum**, with a strong focus on creating practical, industry\-relevant learning experiences for clients and learners.

The role involves **managing both internal and external stakeholders**, understanding client requirements, and working closely with them to develop and customise training programmes, learning content, projects, and assessments. You will collaborate with subject matter experts, trainers, and internal teams to ensure that learning solutions are aligned with industry needs and client expectations.

You should have a strong understanding of **IT Systems Management and related technologies**, including on\-premises server infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and IT service management practices. You should also be able to translate technical knowledge into practical and engaging learning content.

**Job Mission**

You will develop and manage **future\-ready IT Systems Management learning products** that equip learners with practical skills in areas such as cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IT service management.

The role is focused on translating **client and industry requirements into practical training content, projects, assessments, and learning pathways**, while ensuring effective stakeholder engagement and high\-quality delivery.

You will serve as a key bridge between **clients, internal teams, trainers, and technical subject matter experts**, ensuring that curriculum and learning solutions remain relevant, practical, and aligned with current industry practices and technology developments.

**Requirements**

**Job Prerequisite**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Master’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in IT Systems Management, including areas such as on\-premises servers, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in delivering or training Microsoft courses, Project Management, ITIL, or related technical programmes.
* Microsoft Azure certification is required.
* AWS certification is preferred.
* Experience in curriculum development, content development, or learning design is preferred.
* Familiarity with university education frameworks and academic requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable delivering training and supporting learners across different geographies through online learning platforms.

title: Key Account Manager | Walmart |Gurugram
description:
E\-Commerce Key Account Manager – Walmart Sellers

Please read the Job Description carefully before applying.

This role is specifically for professionals with hands\-on experience in E\-commerce / Marketplace Key Account Management.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, results\-driven E\-Commerce Key Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of Walmart Marketplace sellers in the US market.

In this role, you will act as a strategic business partner for assigned Walmart sellers, helping them improve marketplace performance, increase sales, optimize their catalog and listings, resolve operational challenges, and identify opportunities for sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate should have direct experience working with e\-commerce marketplaces/platforms and managing seller or merchant accounts, preferably in a Key Account Manager, Marketplace Account Manager, Seller Success, Marketplace Operations, or similar capacity.

This is not a generic account\-management role. We are specifically looking for professionals who understand how e\-commerce marketplaces work and have experience managing seller/business accounts on platforms such as Walmart Marketplace, Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Ameesha ,Shopify, or similar platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Walmart Seller Account Management

* Own and manage a portfolio of Walmart Marketplace seller accounts in the US.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic business partner for assigned sellers.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with sellers and understand their business objectives.
* Conduct regular account/business reviews and track seller performance against agreed KPIs.
* Identify account\-level risks, opportunities, and growth areas and proactively recommend actions.

Marketplace Growth \& Performance

* Develop and execute strategies to improve seller GMV, sales, conversion, traffic, catalog performance, and overall marketplace growth.
* Analyze seller performance data and identify opportunities for revenue and profitability improvement.
* Recommend appropriate promotional, pricing, advertising, and merchandising strategies.
* Identify high\-potential categories, products, and expansion opportunities.
* Drive seller adoption of relevant Walmart Marketplace programs and initiatives.

Catalog \& Listing Optimization

* Guide sellers on product listing quality, content, attributes, categorization, pricing, and discoverability.
* Work with sellers to improve product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and overall catalog quality.
* Identify listing/content gaps affecting visibility and conversion.
* Monitor product and category performance and recommend corrective actions.

Marketplace Operations

* Support sellers in resolving marketplace\-related operational issues.
* Work with internal teams to address issues related to catalog, inventory, pricing, orders, fulfillment, returns, and seller performance.
* Help sellers understand and improve compliance with marketplace policies and performance standards.
* Proactively identify recurring operational problems and develop solutions.

Strategic Account Management

* Prepare and present regular business reviews, performance insights, action plans, and growth recommendations.
* Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity pipelines, and performance trackers.
* Forecast account growth and identify opportunities to expand seller engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Operations, Catalog, Marketing, Advertising, and Seller Support.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Required Experience

Mandatory:

* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in E\-commerce / Marketplace Key Account Management.
* Experience managing seller/merchant accounts on an e\-commerce marketplace or platform.
* Experience with Walmart Marketplace is highly preferred.
* Candidates with experience managing sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Shopify, or other major marketplaces may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of marketplace metrics such as GMV, revenue, conversion rate, traffic, Buy Box/competitive pricing, catalog quality, inventory, fulfillment, and seller performance.
* Demonstrated experience in growing marketplace accounts and achieving business targets.
* Experience conducting account reviews/business reviews with sellers or merchants.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketplace performance data.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for candidates currently working or previously working as:

* E\-Commerce Key Account Manager
* Marketplace Key Account Manager
* Walmart Account Manager
* Amazon Account Manager
* Marketplace Account Manager
* Seller Success Manager – E\-commerce
* Marketplace Growth Manager
* E\-commerce Business Manager
* Marketplace Operations Manager
* Merchant Success / Seller Success Manager

Candidates from Walmart, Amazon, Meesho, Flipkart, eBay, Shopify, marketplace aggregators, e\-commerce brands, seller agencies, or e\-commerce service providers with relevant seller/account management experience are encouraged to apply.

Who Should NOT Apply

This position is specifically focused on E\-commerce Marketplace Key Account Management.

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily in:

* Banking or financial services
* Insurance
* Loan/credit card sales
* Relationship Manager – Banking
* Branch banking
* General customer service
* BPO/customer support
* Generic client servicing
* Traditional sales/account handling without marketplace experience
* Non\-e\-commerce business development

Only candidates with relevant E\-commerce / Marketplace seller or merchant account management experience will be shortlisted.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of E\-commerce marketplaces
* Seller/Merchant account management
* Walmart Marketplace knowledge preferred
* Marketplace performance analysis
* Business development and revenue growth
* Catalog and listing optimization
* Promotional and pricing strategy
* Strong Excel/data analysis skills
* KPI and performance management
* Stakeholder and relationship management
* Excellent verbal and written English communication
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Ability to manage multiple high\-value seller accounts
* Strategic and commercially driven mindset

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, E\-commerce, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of relevant E\-commerce / Marketplace Account Management experience.
* Proven track record of managing and growing seller/merchant accounts.
* Walmart Marketplace experience will be a strong advantage.

Why Join Us?

* Work closely with US\-based Walmart Marketplace sellers.
* Gain exposure to international e\-commerce marketplace operations.
* Manage high\-impact seller accounts and directly influence business growth.
* Work in a fast\-growing e\-commerce environment.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in marketplace strategy, seller growth, and account management.
